title: Verify provenance
description: The provenance blob of every Verify script: which node ran which tasks, with which wasmtime and runtime module, at which degree, and what each task cost (fuel, peak memory, wall time). A record, not an identity (fuel drifts between hosts, wall times vary); the fleet's inventory is a by-product of any run.

nodes.description: One entry per node that executed a batch, ordered by name.

node_id.description: The node's engine id (the client id on the server).

native_library.description: Where the native wasmtime came from: a path under the module, or "(load context)".

controller.description: The controller version the node ran.

fuel.description: Fuel the node's tasks consumed in total.

runtimes.description: Runtime id → the SHA-256 the module was verified against, for every runtime the node ran.

batches.description: One entry per result batch, ordered by first task index.

degree.description: Concurrent sandboxes the batch ran at.

wall_ms.description: Wall time of the whole batch on the node.

fuel.description: Fuel the batch's tasks consumed in total.

tasks.description: Task indices of the batch, ascending.

metrics.description: One record per task of the batch, in the order of `tasks`: what the task cost on this node. Fuel is reproducible on a host (the cap for a Timeout) but drifts between hosts for CPython tasks; wall time is hardware.
